episodes.title: Saint Nick
episodes.summary: A hit-man is forced to partner with an imaginary blue-winged horse to rescue a missing child.

episodes.title: What Smiles Are For
episodes.summary: Sax crashes a high-stakes poker game to win guns and cash for an escape from New York as Happy tries to convince him he's a father, while ex-wife Amanda and ex-lover Merry team up to rescue Hailey.

episodes.title: When Christmas Was Christmas
episodes.summary: Sax journeys through a dark past while he and Happy track his daughter, Merry and Amanda make a chilling discovery, and Very Bad Santa coerces information out of Hailey about her "hero" dad.

episodes.title: Year of the Horse
episodes.summary: Sax and Happy follow their fortunes to Chinatown while Blue's sister shows up seeking revenge for the murder of her sons, and Merry's search draws her ever closer to Very Bad Santa.

episodes.title: White Sauce? Hot Sauce?
episodes.summary: Sax and Happy have a difference of opinion following a destructive family reunion, Merry is under investigation by Internal Affairs, and Hailey and the other children are introduced to a far more terrifying prison.

episodes.title: The Scrapyard of Childish Things
episodes.summary: Sax and Happy embark on lonely journey in which Sax stumbles on a new plan to negotiate for his daughter's release and Happy takes solace in the welcoming arms of another Imaginary Friend.

episodes.title: Destroyer of Worlds
episodes.summary: Finally reunited, Sax and Happy make one last push to save Hailey, Amanda pursues a dangerous lead all by herself, and Blue and Isabella come to blows over a dark family secret.

episodes.title: I Am the Future
episodes.summary: With Christmas approaching, Sax and Happy are locked in a climatic confrontation to rescue Hailey from Very Bad Santa's lair, and Merry sets out to save Amanda from a far more powerful foe.

episodes.title: The War on Easter
episodes.summary: Sax is clean...ish... but somehow the filth just seems to find him.

episodes.title: Tallahassee
episodes.summary: Hailey spends a day with dad; these mitzvahs are murder.

episodes.title: Some Girls Need a Lot of Repenting
episodes.summary: A simple B&E, they said; introducing the captivating Bebe DeBarge; a very Smoothie Easter egg hunt.

episodes.title: Blitzkrieg!!!
episodes.summary: Dayglo Doug; Sax, Merry and Happy enter a geriatric death trap.

episodes.title: 19 Hours and 13 Minutes
episodes.summary: Sax eats the jelly and trips B, D, all of it, and all on Hailey's birthday; Amanda makes a breakthrough.

episodes.title: Pervapalooza
episodes.summary: Meet Janet, you ape. Happy moves way past the (imaginary) Friend Zone. Sax and Merry get slimy.

episodes.title: Arlo and Marie
episodes.summary: This is one F-d up family dinner.

episodes.title: A Friend of Death
episodes.summary: Smoothie and Hailey take a trip into the past; Sax hits rock bottom; Happy brought a cake.

episodes.title: Five Chicken Fingers and a Gun
episodes.summary: Amanda's blessed day arrives; Sax and Amanda will have to play Smoothie's game to get to Hailey.

episodes.title: Resurrection
episodes.summary: Sonny's Eggtacular = lit. Sax, Amanda, Happy save Hailey from worse than death.
